idea-plugin.name: Coverage Gate Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the coverage gates in your repo that can never fail a build

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Coverage Gate Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 14 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/coverage-gate-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/coverage-gate-lint

action.text: Coverage Gate Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Coverage Gate Lint on the file in the editor
